clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Krusk at last hears word and rumor of Gol'dir, an orc held prisoner by the Syndicate. The humans keep moving their captive about, so Krusk has narrowed the search to the Syndicate's large camp, just to the north of town, and wants you to bring back whatever information you can find.

Krusk has begun to hear word and rumor of Gol'dir. The Syndicate's humans keep moving the orc about, but the search is narrowing to their large camp, just to the north of Tarren Mill. Krusk sends you there to lay hands on whatever information you can and carry it back. Krusk fears that with each day Gol'dir's prospects darken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: At last we begin to hear word and rumor, find evidence of Gol'dir's whereabouts. The humans have been moving him around, but we are narrowing down our search and focusing on the large Syndicate camp just north of here.
Go there, friend, and bring back whatever information you can get your hands on.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found anything? I fear Gol'dir's prospects grow worse by the day...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally, we know where Gol'dir is being held. The camp in question is not too far from here, and hopefully they will not be as well prepared as they were when they captured us the first time.
